text:
Aisha CS: quick week0 gatekeeping sync for Lyncrest private/VPC onboarding. High-level: networking egress, IAM roles for cross-account logging, KMS key access, and audit log delivery. Renewal rep flagged a potential contract review if we don't validate audit stream this week. Can we list open blockers?
Oliver (Lyncrest): thanks Aisha. Main blockers: 1) audit events not appearing in our SIEM (Graylog). 2) our infra team needs the exact role arn to add to their trust policy. 3) want confirmation of KMS usage and rotation plan.
Ben (NetOps): on egress I see traffic hitting our proxy but TLS is being terminated there and our Graylog collector rejects client certs. Need collector hostnames or IPs and thumbprint for mutual TLS.
Oliver (Lyncrest): collectors: gray-a.prod.lyncrest.net (44.210.11.99) and gray-b.prod.lyncrest.net (44.210.12.100). Thumbprint: 3A:4F:9B:... (we'll DM full).
Ben (NetOps): ok will open egress rules and add outbound-only to those two IPs. Snippet for firewall change: ```gcloud compute firewall-rules update allow-lyncrest-siem --allow tcp:6514 --destination-ranges 44.210.11.99/32,44.210.12.100/32``` will roll in 10m.
Priya (SolutionsEng): IAM: Lyncrest needs the exact role ARN to attach to their logging sidecar. Use: arn:aws:iam::888777666555:role/lyncrest-log-writer. Also they need sts:AssumeRole trust from our logging service principal.
Marco (Security): KMS constraints: we can permit decrypt/generate-data-key for the lyncrest role but must scope by encryption context to the audit-log stream. Provide policy snippet we can paste.
Marco (Security): policy example: ```{"Sid":"AllowLyncrestLogs","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::888777666555:role/lyncrest-log-writer"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:EncryptionContext:log-source":"lyncrest-audit"}}}``` apply to customer CMK.
Priya (SolutionsEng): once Marco posts final JSON, we'll coordinate a key rotation window. Proposed window: Fri 02:00 UTC (low traffic). Does that work for Lyncrest?
Oliver (Lyncrest): Fri 02:00 UTC is fine. We'll pause ingestion for 15m and re-run.
Aisha CS: action items: 1) Ben will open firewall to two Graylog IPs (ETA 10m). 2) Marco to share final KMS policy JSON (ETA 1h). 3) Priya to schedule key rotation Fri 02:00 UTC and send invite. 4) Oliver to run a post-rotation ingestion test and paste a sample. Note renewal check next Mon; we need audit delivery + key rotation validated by EOD Fri to avoid escalation.
Ben (NetOps): firewall rules applied. Verified outbound from test instance: tcp 6514 to 44.210.11.99 connects.
infra-bot: syslog-forwarder job #3312 started -> status: running.
Marco (Security): uploaded final KMS policy to the shared drive and pasted snippet here (redacted). Priya, schedule rotation?
Priya (SolutionsEng): rotation scheduled Fri 02:00 UTC, calendar invite sent to Lyncrest ops and our infra oncall.
Oliver (Lyncrest): ran a quick post-change check after firewall change: still seeing TLS handshake failures initially but retried and now receiving 202 ACKs. sample: "{\"ts\":\"2026-03-22T21:10:12Z\",\"status\":202,\"msg\":\"event accepted\"}"
Priya (SolutionsEng): after KMS rotation run we'll look for any KMS:AccessDenied spikes in CloudTrail and a reduction in lambda 403s. Please capture 5-min tails pre/post.
infra-bot: syslog-forwarder job #3312 finished -> status: success, 0 errors.
Aisha CS: solid progress. Marking thread as active/in-flight. I'll post a concise health summary before the renewal check-in on Mon. If anything regresses, escalate to CS manager. :white_check_mark:
